purpose: Document city-local land/property registry or map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: The official Gaya district land-records page points users to Bihar land-record services, and the Bihar BhuNaksha public map exposes the district/subdivision/circle/mauza/survey hierarchy. This confirms local records and parcel-map indexing for Gaya, but not anonymous full-vector access. The official BhuNaksha client exposes parcel maps as WMS imagery and plot selection/detail routes, but no public full-geometry vector endpoint was identified. WMS tiles and plot-detail routes were not queried for parcel records.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Gaya district land-records page provides the local government land-record service entry point.
Official Bihar Revenue Department portal links revenue land records and cadastral map services.

Public Bihar BhuNaksha map shell has district, subdivision, circle, mauza and survey/map selectors. Client JavaScript uses WMS imagery and plot-selection/detail routes; no full geometry response was requested or returned.
